provider.description: Qualified provider ID from list_models. Optional: when left out, this thread's provider and model are used.

model.description: Model ID from list_models. Defaults to the provider's first model, or to this thread's model when no provider is given.

options.description: Model settings by setting ID, as list_models shows them, for example { "effort": "medium" }.

text.description: Optional first message to send to the new thread.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for the new thread; plan is read-only. Defaults to standard, or this thread's mode if stricter. It may not be looser than this thread's mode.
